findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url_parse · Private data: gtin_barcode_validate, url_parse, jwt_decode, geohash_encode_decode · Public sink: dst_transitions · Destructive: isin_cusip_sedol_validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: url_parse · Private data: gtin_barcode_validate, url_parse, jwt_decode, geohash_encode_decode · Public sink: dst_transitions · Destructive: isin_cusip_sedol_validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
